about: S5.WCX: the part C answers of the paid probes P-M (2026-10-17, the provisional prompts, reasoning low) and P-R (2026-10-17, the translator in four reasoning arms), text only: no photo id, no hash, no idea but the probes' own set. Each answer is tied to the KIND of frame it was made for. The translations are tagged with what they did to the idea's meaning (the owner's eye and pm.md / pr.md): faithful, substituted (another motion in its place), softened (made slow), dropped (a part left out) or merged (two movements said as one). Round 2: px holds P-X (2026-10-23), the WCX texts live on grok-4.3 (the translator on effort none, the writer on low), each answer as the model gave it.
